description: This PHP file contains the implementation of an OAuth2 AccessTokenRepository within the SuiteCRM platform. It provides methods to persist, revoke, verify revocation status, and generate new access tokens, interacting with OAuth2 token entities and database records specifically for access tokens.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 access token persistence, revocation, validation, and creation logic for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Stores a new access token in the database, setting relevant fields like expiry, client, and user.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Marks an existing access token as revoked based on its token ID.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a given access token has been revoked or expired.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth2 access token entity associated with the specified client, scopes, and optionally a user.
